stream_protocol.source_basis: Complete pinned freebuf/fclose/fflush/access/waccess sources and COFF owners; real FILE and SDK declarations
stream_protocol.policy_basis: Free only active CRT-owned buffers; flush compares full requested byte count and always resets pointer/count; close orders flush/free/close and frees filename only after successful close; access uses attributes/write bit and actual A import, without added ACL or mode validation
stream_protocol.runtime_unknowns: Caller-held stream lock, real stream/handle/buffer/name ownership, write/close results, caller path/mode, ACP and runtime error state
